headline: Reserve Bank of India Allots ₹50,003 Crore in Variable Rate Repo Auction
summary: The RBI conducted a 2-day Variable Rate Repo auction, receiving ₹1,37,612 crore in bids against a ₹50,000 crore notified amount and allotting ₹50,003 crore at a cutoff rate of 5.64%.
why: The Reserve Bank of India uses repo auctions to manage short-term liquidity within the domestic banking sector.
